title: Modeled reduction after recurrence
method: Synthetic baseline comparison: $800 initial reduction minus $250 recurring waste equals $550. Preventing $200 of recurrence yields $750 reduction. Excludes implementation effort and changes in legitimate demand.
alt: Modeled reduction after recurrence. Initial cleanup: 800 USD/month; After recurrence: 550 USD/month; With prevention: 750 USD/month. Illustrative values.
